newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 21.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 21.

text.p: * Olsten Corp said it expected fourth quarter earnings to come in below forecasts at $0.20 per share. It said fiscal 1996 net per share would be $1.30. The stock closed at 19-7/8 on Wednesday.
* Sunglass Hut International Inc reported a third quarter per share loss of $0.05, compared to a profit of $0.05 a year ago. The First Call estimate was a loss of $0.01. The stock closed at 7-3/8.

* Shares of General Motors Corp were up 3/8 to 57-1/2 in London on a reassessment of the company's deal with the United Auto Workers union. Other auto shares rose in sympathy, with Chrysler Corp up 1/4 at 34-1/2 and Ford Motor Co up 1/8 at 32-5/8.

* High tech stocks were up in London on positive comments in the Wall Street Journal. International Business Machines Corp was up 1/2 at 153-1/4, Texas Instruments Inc added 1/4 to 55-1/4, and Digital Equipment Corp rose 1/4 to 35-1/4.
